notes: Convex polygon intersection of rotated block rectangles and finite road rectangles; no rounded road caps.
Centerline graph allows intersections and endpoint proximity <= 0.25; it ignores block obstruction.
Road surface components use positive overlap between finite road rectangles; they ignore the all-island asphalt underlay.
Lot reservations are computed from the original planBlockLots source, with isolated RNG; they do not reproduce final renderer random state or mesh decoration.
